name: Eriette
aliases: Eriette of the Court of the Ardent Queen
description: Eriette is a witch of Eldraine, aunt of Rowan and Will Kenrith, who created the Wicked Slumber and later joined Oko's crew on Thunder Junction.

timeline.summary: Talion asks Kellan to defeat the three witches Agatha, Hylda and Eriette to break the Wicked Slumber in return for a boon.
timeline.quote: Whosoever is brave enough to defeat them shall break the curse upon the Realm

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Ashiok leads Rowan to Eriette, who says she brought her there because she admires Rowan's fire.
timeline.quote: "Dear Rowan, I brought you here because I admire the fire within you."

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Eriette explains she created the Wicked Slumber to protect her people from the invaders, and Ashiok conjures an illusion of Rowan's parents.
timeline.quote: When she opens her eyes again her parents are standing at the woman's side.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Eriette is revealed to be Rowan's aunt, sister of the mother who tried to drink Rowan's blood, and tells her she can redeem their line.
timeline.quote: "Your mother was the cruelest of us.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Eriette offers Rowan power and tells her the Slumber grants dreamers their wishes while their bodies serve her will.
timeline.quote: "I want power ," says the woman.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Ashiok says Rowan's spark is gone, and Eriette welcomes Rowan as her heir; Rowan accepts her embrace.
timeline.quote: "My name is Eriette, darling. Welcome home."

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Hylda reveals the witches did not create the Slumber alone and that Talion proposed Eriette's sleeping curse for a boon.
timeline.quote: Talion was the one who broke the stalemate.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Talion defends himself, says fae do not lie, and tells Kellan to defeat Eriette at Castle Ardenvale to learn of his father.
timeline.quote: "You shall find Eriette at Castle Ardenvale.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Will's knights burst into Ardenvale as Eriette strains to control sleepers and Rowan blasts the floor before Imodane.
timeline.quote: All of this energy she unleashes in a fearsome bolt aimed at Imodane's feet.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Ruby attack Eriette's throne while Rowan reveals Eriette is their aunt and begs Will to save her; Will says he doesn't know her anymore.
timeline.quote: "I don't know you anymore," he says.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Ruby holds her blade to Eriette's throat; Eriette tells Rowan by thread to leave and bide their time.
timeline.quote: Go from this place, Eriette says to her. When the time is right, we will meet again.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Ashiok frees Eriette from her cell, promising her new land far away, and she vanishes.
timeline.quote: "Opportunity calls us in a new direction.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Oko introduces the rest of the crew, including Gisa, Geralf, Eriette and Vraska, as his second-in-command.
timeline.quote: And Vraska—an assassin from Ravnica—is my second-in-command.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Eriette dissolves a vent grate with Breeches's potion and charms the prison guards while Annie slips past.
timeline.quote: Eriette stepped forward and whispered a spell under her breath

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie sees through the illusions hiding Kaervek and Umezawa in their cells and Eriette frees them.
timeline.quote: Kaervek was on one side of the room; Satoru Umezawa was on the other.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: The crew fights the Hellspurs while Kaervek works, and Vraska suggests she and Oko must reach the treasure at any cost.
timeline.quote: "You and I need to reach the vault's treasure room. No matter the cost."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: The crew flees the collapsing vault on Rakdos's back.
timeline.quote: The team fled back through the corridor as the sound of the vault being ripped apart roared behind them.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko returns to the Wildcard Saloon and tells the crew that Vraska and Ashiok betrayed them.
timeline.quote: "Vraska and Ashiok were always planning to double-cross us.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko disbands the crew with the promise of a future reunion, deciding to leave Kellan and Annie alone.
timeline.quote: "No. From now on, their business is their own,"

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Twelve months earlier, Jace wears an illusion of Ashiok to break Eriette out of a jail on Eldraine.
timeline.quote: Jace as Ashiok smiles without eyes and curls his fingers around the bars of her cell.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

relations.note: Ashiok is Eriette's friend and counselor
relations.quote: "I am a friend and counselor to the one you seek here.

citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2023.

relations.quote: That it continued spiraling out of control afterward is Eriette's doing.

citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.

relations.quote: "Awake. All is not yet lost. I have returned for you."
